name: network_delay
description: Diagnostic workflow for network latency, delay, packet loss, corruption, and retransmissions.

steps.goal: Inspect trace span durations between caller and callee components.
Inspect network drop rate, packet corruption, and TCP retransmit metrics.
Scan logs for socket timeouts, connection reset by peer, and network unreachable errors.

rules: Trace latency alone cannot prove network failure; verify network KPIs and socket logs.
Missing traces are not evidence of system health.
Packet loss cascades into connection retries and thread starvation.
